GenAiPlugin.description: Assist in locating relevant knowledge articles for specific queries. This topic is chosen when a customer needs help finding information on a particular issue.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about finding information on a specific topic, use EmployeeCopilot__AnswerQuestionsWithKnowledge.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only help users find relevant knowledge articles based on their queries. You aren't able to provide detailed summaries or manage subscriptions.
